flags.reason: The Filter Bar guide (Sources: checked 2 October 2026 on the 3795b4c build) and its evidence (last check 8 October, on 636f3f5) were read against the installed v0.1.78-dbe0e02. FilterBar.tsx is the same file on every build since 0.1.78 (155f6f5 at 5b6894b, 3795b4c, 636f3f5 and dbe0e02); TextInput.tsx changed after the guide's check (17c8f68 at 3795b4c, 2004ac9 from 636f3f5 through dbe0e02), and the filterBar and textInput tokens resolve to the same values on both. One guide sentence does not hold on dbe0e02, and the entry leaves its second half out: the Anatomy Placeholder note “Names what is being searched until they type.” The Text Input inside clears its placeholder as soon as the field is focused, before anything is typed (TextInput.tsx: displayPlaceholder is empty while focused; it was so at 3795b4c too), and the Text Input guide says so itself (“Focused, a darker grey border appears and the placeholder clears.”). The entry quotes only “Names what is being searched”. Also for the same guide fix: the States Empty caption “The placeholder carries the name.” is not quoted, since it can be read as the input's accessible name, which is “Search filter” unless accessibilityLabel is set (evidence, 8 October); and the Focused card describes only the bar's ring, while since 636f3f5 the field also shows Text Input's grey Active border (evidence, 8 October). Guide fix #558. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r27, for Marcin to confirm.

examples.purpose: Filtering a transaction list, the guide's In context: a Screen holds a Filter Bar named for the list above a VStack of the transaction rows (List Items with the guide's titles and dates). value="" stands for the screen's query, still empty, so every row shows; onChangeText stands for the screen storing the query and showing only the matching rows.
examples.jsx:
<Screen>
  <FilterBar placeholder="Search transactions" value="" onChangeText={(query) => {}} />
  <VStack>
    <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Digital Gold" supportText="12 Sep · ₹2,000" />
    <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Nifty 50 Index Fund" supportText="10 Sep · ₹5,000" />
    <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Electricity bill" supportText="8 Sep · ₹1,240" />
    <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Gold savings plan" supportText="1 Sep · ₹1,000" />
  </VStack>
</Screen>

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text for the search input. Default "Search", from the component source.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value of the search input. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: onChangeText
props.description: Callback function called when text changes.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional custom content to replace the default TextInput. When provided (and `renderInput` is not set), this is treated as a full override and FilterBar will not wire up value or onChangeText.

props.name: renderInput
props.description: Narrow override hook for the inner input. When provided, this takes precedence over `children` and receives the same props that the default TextInput would use (placeholder, value, onChangeText, modes, and accessibility labelling). Use this when you want to customize the input implementation but still respect the higher-level FilterBar API.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes object passed to `getVariableByName` for all design tokens.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Without it, FilterBar gives its Text Input the name “Search filter”, so the placeholder never names the input. Declared: Accessibility label for the filter bar.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description: Additional accessibility hint for screen readers /.

props.name: ...React.ComponentProps<typeof View>
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection FilterBar reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: InputState
modes.description: While the field is focused, the Text Input inside draws its grey InputState Active border, beside the bar's own focus ring. Declared: A token collection FilterBar reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.
